VI.description: Packs the eDyno simulator state into the signal values of eDyno_NVH_PoC.dbc\2C in the order of Signal List (frame.signal names for XNET Create Session (Generic)\2C Signal Output Single-point). Signal List is the single source of the order - create the XNET session from it. Active Fault Id\3A 0 none\2C 1-5 one fault (Imbalance\2C Misalignment\2C BPFO\2C Torque Ripple\2C PWM)\2C 6 several. Alive counters = Status.Alive Counter mod 16 - wire the CAN loop iteration so they step on every write.
